subject: Botany
source_note: Compiled from the NTA/NMC NEET UG 2026 Biology syllabus (officially released 8 Jan 2026, largely unchanged from 2025 with only minor NCERT-aligned sub-topic deletions) as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources, cross-checked Sep 2026. NEET's Biology syllabus is not split into separate 'Botany' and 'Zoology' papers by NTA - both are drawn from one 90-question Biology section - but question banks and most coaching trackers conventionally split the 10 official Biology units into a Botany half and a Zoology half, which this file follows (mirrors neet_syllabus_zoology.json). Genetics/Evolution units are split across the two files by convention; verify against the official NTA/NMC syllabus PDF for the exact unit list before finalising a bank.
exam_pattern_note: NEET UG Biology: 100 questions printed (Section A: 70 single-correct MCQs compulsory, Section B: 30 single-correct MCQs, attempt any 20 - best 20 scored), split evenly in most banks into 45 Botany-origin and 45 Zoology-origin questions of the 90 scored. Single-correct MCQ format only.

subtopics: What is living? Biodiversity, need for classification, three domains of life
Five-kingdom classification, salient features of each kingdom
Systematics and binomial nomenclature basics
Salient features and classification of Plantae: Algae, Bryophyta, Pteridophyta, Gymnosperms, Angiosperms
Morphology of flowering plants: root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit, seed
Description of a typical leguminous seed and a monocot/dicot family (descriptive botany)
Anatomy: tissues and tissue systems of dicots and monocots
Secondary growth (qualitative)
Cell theory, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cell structure
Cell wall, cell membrane, cell organelles and their functions
Biomolecules: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids (structure and function)
Cell cycle and cell division: mitosis and meiosis
Transport in plants: diffusion, osmosis, plant-water relations, long-distance transport
Mineral nutrition: essential minerals, deficiency symptoms, nitrogen metabolism (basic)
Photosynthesis: light and dark reactions, C3/C4 pathways, factors affecting rate
Respiration in plants: glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport, fermentation
Plant growth and development: growth regulators (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ethylene, ABA)
Flower structure, development of male and female gametophytes
Pollination: types, agencies, outbreeding devices
Double fertilisation, post-fertilisation events, seed and fruit development
Apomixis and polyembryony (brief)
DNA structure and packaging, DNA replication
Central dogma, transcription, genetic code, translation
Gene regulation: the lac operon
Human genome project and DNA fingerprinting (basic concepts)
Microbes in household products and industrial production
Microbes in sewage treatment and biogas production
Microbes as biocontrol agents and biofertilisers
Principles of genetic engineering: restriction enzymes, cloning vectors, competent host
Tools and processes: PCR, gel electrophoresis, downstream processing
Applications in agriculture (Bt crops), medicine (insulin, gene therapy) and transgenic organisms
Biosafety issues, biopiracy and patents (basic awareness)
Organisms and populations: population interactions, population growth, attributes
Ecosystem: structure, function, energy flow, ecological pyramids, nutrient cycling
Biodiversity and conservation: patterns, loss, conservation strategies
Environmental issues (qualitative, trimmed in 2024-25 rationalisation)
